DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十月五日零時二十分の便を考えています。駅へ来るのは四日の夜で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五日零時二十分の便に乗るため四日の夜に来る予定でよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm considering the departure at 12:20 a.m. on October 5. Is it correct that I should come to the station on the night of the 4th?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese whether you should come on the night of the 4th to take the departure at 12:20 a.m. on the 5th.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付が変わった後の出発ですね。購入したい便の画面はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That departure is after the date changes. Do you have the screen for the service you'd like to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この画面です。夜に出るつもりなので、四日の便を買いそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面を示し、夜出発と思って四日を買いかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Since I was planning to leave at night, I nearly bought a ticket for the 4th.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the screen and explain in Japanese that you nearly bought the 4th because you were thinking of a nighttime departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示は五日零時二十分です。四日の夜から待つ予定なら、その後に日付が変わる便です。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It shows 12:20 a.m. on the 5th. If you plan to wait from the night of the 4th, this service departs after the date changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発日は五日と選ぶんですね。四日二十二時の別の便とは区別したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発日は五日と理解し、四日二十二時の別便と区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should select the 5th as the departure date. I want to distinguish it from the other service at 10 p.m. on the 4th.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the departure date is the 5th and want to distinguish it from the separate 10 p.m. service on the 4th.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらの画面には二つの便があります。どちらを希望しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, these two services are shown on this screen. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 五日零時二十分の方です。仕事が終わってから駅に来るので、四日二十二時には間に合いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事後に来るため四日二十二時には間に合わず、五日零時二十分を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The 12:20 a.m. one on the 5th. I'll come to the station after work, so I won't make it by 10 p.m. on the 4th.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want 12:20 a.m. on the 5th because you will arrive after work and cannot make 10 p.m. on the 4th.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらを選択しました。乗車日と出発時刻をもう一度ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've selected this one. Please check the travel date and departure time once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五日零時二十分になっています。この便を購入し、四日の夜に来る予定を手帳にも書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面の日付と時刻を確認して購入し、前夜に来る予定も手帳に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It says 12:20 a.m. on the 5th. I'll buy this service and also write in my planner that I should come on the night of the 4th.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the screen date and time in Japanese, say you will buy the ticket, and record your plan to come the previous night in your planner.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。日付を取り違えずにご準備ください。お気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please prepare carefully so you don't mix up the dates. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。展示について何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 解説の「運行」という言葉がわかりません。車を運転する説明かと思ったので、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示の運行という語を車の運転かと思ったため意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't understand the word “unkō” in the explanation. I thought it was explaining how to drive a car, so could you tell me what it means?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what “unkō” means in the exhibit, explaining that you thought it referred to driving a car.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この解説では祭りの山車が通りを進むことを指しています。どの表示をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this explanation, it means festival floats proceeding along the street. Which sign were you reading?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この大きな展示の横です。人も一緒に歩くと書いてありますが、車の話ではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 該当表示を示し、人も歩くとの説明は車の話ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one beside this large exhibit. It says people walk along too, so it isn't about cars, then?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the sign and confirm in Japanese that the explanation about people walking is not about cars.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この写真にも山車と参加者が写っています。展示中の物がいま動くという案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. This photo also shows a float and participants. It isn't saying that the object on display is moving now.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は動く実演があると読み違えていました。展示と祭りの写真を分けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 動く実演と読み違えたと認め、展示と祭り写真を分けて理解したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I misread it as saying there would be a moving demonstration today. I'd like to understand the exhibit and the festival photos separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Admit the misunderstanding in Japanese that you expected a moving demonstration, and say you want to distinguish the exhibit from the festival photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの写真は祭り当日の様子です。今の展示の説明は、この白い札にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: This photo shows the day of the festival. The explanation for the current exhibit is on this white label.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真の日の出来事と、今日の展示を区別します。「運行」の説明を自分のメモに書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真の時点と今日の展示を区別し、語の説明をメモしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll distinguish what happened on the day in the photo from today's exhibit. May I write down the explanation of “unkō” in my notes?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish the time of the photo from today's exhibit, and ask to note down the word's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身のメモは取れます。ほかに理解しにくい言葉があれば、この札を示してお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may take personal notes. If there are any other words you find hard to understand, please show us this label and ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 山車が通りを進むこと、とメモしました。今日その場で動く予定だとは考えず、展示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 山車が進む意味を記録し、今日の実演を前提にせず見学すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written down “a festival float proceeding along the street.” I'll view the exhibit without assuming it is scheduled to move here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you recorded the meaning of a float moving along the street, and will view the exhibit without assuming there is a demonstration today.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご質問ありがとうございました。見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for your question. Enjoy the exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お土産について何をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What souvenirs are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このジュースを二箱買い、別々の住所へ送りたいです。一つの箱にまとめないでお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ジュース二箱を二住所へ分け、一箱にまとめず配送したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy two boxes of this juice and send them to separate addresses. Could you please avoid combining them into one box?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to send two boxes of juice to two addresses separately, without combining them into one box.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品は二件に分けて配送できます。送り先は二つとも国内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can ship this product as two separate deliveries. Are both destinations within Japan?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、兄と姉の自宅です。住所はこの紙で別々に控えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 国内の兄と姉の住所を別々に控えていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, my older brother's and older sister's homes. I've written down their addresses separately on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have separately recorded your older brother's and older sister's addresses within Japan.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一箱ずつの配送料金はこちらです。二件分の料金になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the shipping charge for each box. You will be charged for two deliveries.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二件分を確認しました。兄の箱にはこのカード、姉の箱にはもう一枚のカードを入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二件分の料金を了承し、各箱に違うカードを同封したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've checked the charges for both deliveries. Please put this card in my brother's box and the other card in my sister's box.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the charges for two deliveries in Japanese and ask to include a different card in each box.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードをそれぞれの箱に添えます。宛名のラベルと一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll include each card with its respective box. Let's check them together with the address labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらが兄宛てで、青いカードです。姉宛ては白いカードです。逆にならないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 兄には青カード、姉には白カードと宛名を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one is for my brother, with the blue card. The white card is for my sister. Please make sure they aren't switched.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the address labels in Japanese: the blue card is for your older brother and the white one for your older sister.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛名とカードが一致しています。配送の控えも二件分お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The addresses and cards match. We'll also give you separate shipping receipts for both deliveries.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの宛先とカードを確認できました。控えも分けて保管し、家族へそれぞれ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先とカードの一致を確認し、控えも分けて家族へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've confirmed both destinations and cards. I'll keep the receipts separately too, and notify each family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the addresses and cards match, and say you will keep the receipts separately and contact each family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二件に分けて承りました。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We've accepted them as two separate shipments. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察券がないので初診の受付をしましたが、以前来たことがあります。受付の内容を訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前の来院があるため、診察券なしで選んだ初診受付を訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I registered as a first-time patient because I don't have my patient card, but I've been here before. I'd like to correct my registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have visited before and want to correct the first-visit registration you chose because you had no patient card.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の受診はいつごろでしたか。診察券番号はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: About when was your previous visit? Do you know your patient card number?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一年ほど前です。番号はわかりませんが、名前と生年月日は伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 約一年前の受診で番号不明だが名前と生年月日は伝えられると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: About a year ago. I don't know the number, but I can give you my name and date of birth.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your previous visit was about a year ago and you do not know the number, but can provide your name and date of birth.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人情報で確認します。以前とは住所や名前が変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check using your personal details. Has your address or name changed since then?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前は同じですが、住所は変わっています。前の住所と今の住所を分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前は同じで住所が変わり、旧新住所を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My name is the same, but my address has changed. I'll give you my old and current addresses separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your name is unchanged but your address has changed, and provide the old and new addresses separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた履歴と照合します。今日はどのような症状で来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll compare them with the records we can find. What symptoms brought you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日から頭が痛いです。以前と同じ症状かどうかは、自分では判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日から頭痛があるが以前と同症状かは判断できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've had a headache since yesterday. I can't tell myself whether it's the same symptom as before.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have had a headache since yesterday but cannot judge whether it is the same as before.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過を担当へ伝えます。以前の受診情報と今日の症状は分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll pass that history to the person responsible. We'll check your previous visit information separately from today's symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 初めてではないと訂正し、今の住所と昨日からの症状を伝えます。痛みが変わったら職員に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再来院と現住所、今の症状を伝え、変化があれば職員へ知らせると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll correct it to say this isn't my first visit, and give my current address and the symptoms I've had since yesterday. If the pain changes, I'll tell a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese your return visit, current address and present symptoms, and that you will notify staff if anything changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。内容を訂正して担当へ引き継ぎます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll correct the details and hand them over to the person responsible. Thank you for discussing this with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の携帯が見つかりません。自分の携帯と特徴を取り違えそうなので、区別して説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事用携帯の紛失について私用端末と特徴を区別して説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my work phone. I'm afraid I might confuse its features with those of my personal phone, so I'd like to describe them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to distinguish your lost work phone's features from those of your personal phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 仕事用と私用の二台があるのですね。なくなった方の所有者はどなたですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you have two phones, one for work and one personal. Who owns the missing one?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社から借りている端末です。私用の携帯は今ここにあり、なくなっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紛失品は会社からの貸与品で、私物は手元にあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a device loaned to me by my company. My personal phone is here with me now and isn't missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the missing phone belongs to your company, while your personal phone is with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会社の端末の特徴を、確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have any documents that can confirm the company phone's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の管理表の控えがあります。仕事用は白いケースで、私用の黒いケースとは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の管理表を示し、仕事用白ケースと私用黒ケースを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a copy of the company's device register. The work phone has a white case, unlike my personal phone's black case.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the company's register and distinguish the work phone's white case from your personal phone's black case in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理番号と、会社へ連絡したかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me the asset number and whether you've contacted your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理番号は端末欄のＣ一七です。会社の担当にも紛失を伝えましたが、遠隔操作が済んだかは未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理番号Ｃ一七と会社への連絡済みを伝え、遠隔対応結果は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The asset number is C17 in the device column. I've also told the person responsible at my company about the loss, but haven't confirmed whether remote action has been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give asset number C17 in Japanese, say you have notified your company, and explain that the result of remote action is still unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 端末の特徴と、会社への連絡状況を分けて記録します。私用端末の番号を紛失品の番号にしないよう確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record the device's features separately from the status of your contact with the company. Let's make sure not to enter your personal phone's number as the missing device's number.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 白いケースの会社端末Ｃ一七が紛失品です。私物は手元にあると確認し、会社には保護対応の結果を別に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紛失した会社端末と手元の私物を確認し、保護対応は会社へ別に照会すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The missing item is the company's C17 device with a white case. My personal phone is with me, and I'll separately ask my company about the result of their protective measures.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese which company phone is missing and that your own phone is with you, and say you will separately ask your company about protective action.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。会社の端末として状況を伺います。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll take the details as a missing company device. Thank you for coming to discuss it.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。案内所で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can we help you at the information desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 成人の友人と別々に買い物していますが、携帯が使えません。待ち合わせの案内を頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯が使えず別行動中の成人友人へ待合せの案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My adult friend and I are shopping separately, but I can't use my phone. Could you make an announcement about meeting up?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a meeting announcement for an adult friend shopping separately because you cannot use your phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人が迷子だということではなく、集合場所を知らせたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your friend isn't lost; you just want to tell them where to meet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、お互い好きな店へ行きました。困っていると決めつけず、集合場所だけ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 互いに自由に買物中で、迷子や困窮と断定せず集合場所だけ伝えたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, we each went to the shops we wanted to visit. I just want to tell them the meeting point, without assuming they're in trouble.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are both shopping freely and only want to give the meeting point, without describing your friend as lost or in trouble.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内所へのお呼出しができます。お名前の読み方をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can call them to this information desk. Please tell me how to pronounce their name.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: グエン・リンです。名前が長いので、この紙のカタカナを読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前の読みをカタカナの紙で示して放送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's Nguyen Linh. The name is long, so could you read the katakana on this paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the name's pronunciation on the katakana paper and ask for an announcement in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの読みで放送します。ご本人は放送の後も案内所でお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll use this pronunciation in the announcement. Can you stay at the information desk after the announcement too?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、ここで待ちます。放送してもすぐ来るとは限らないので、別の店へ探しに出ません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 放送後も案内所で待ち、すぐ来ると決めず別の店へ探しに行かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll wait here. They might not arrive immediately after the announcement, so I won't go looking in another shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stay at the information desk after the announcement, without assuming an immediate arrival or searching other shops.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一度お呼出しします。しばらく待っても来られなければ、次の連絡方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll make one announcement. If they haven't come after you've waited a while, please discuss another way of making contact with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一度の放送で案内所に集まる内容をお願いします。来たら、呼出しが終わったとこちらへ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一度の呼出しで案内所集合を希望し、合流したら係員へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please make one announcement asking them to meet me at the information desk. Once they arrive, I'll tell you that the call is no longer needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for one announcement to meet at the information desk, and say you will inform staff once you reunite.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内所へのお呼出しをします。ご相談ありがとうございます。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll call them to the information desk. Thank you for asking. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。果物について何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What fruit are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族にりんごを頼まれました。いま連絡を見たら、ふじという品種の指定があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族からふじ指定の連絡を見たので該当品種を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family asked me to buy apples. I just checked their message, and they specified the Fuji variety.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your family's message specified Fuji apples, so you are looking for that variety.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かごの商品はこちらの王林です。ふじの表示がある袋をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The product in your basket is Orin. I'll show you the bags labelled Fuji.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 色だけで選んでいました。この袋はまだ買っていないので、王林を戻して選び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色で王林を選んだと認め、未購入なので戻して選び直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was choosing just by color. I haven't bought this bag yet, so I'd like to put the Orin back and choose again.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit in Japanese that you chose Orin by color, and say you want to return the unpurchased bag and choose again.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の棚はこちらです。ふじは隣の棚で、袋の札に品種名があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the original shelf. Fuji apples are on the next shelf, with the variety named on the bag's label.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ふじと書いてあります。この袋は四個ですね。頼まれた数は六個なので、ばら売りもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ふじ四個入りを確認し、必要六個にするためばら売りの有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says Fuji. This bag has four apples, right? I was asked for six, so do you also sell them individually?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the bag contains four Fuji apples in Japanese, and ask about individual ones to reach the six requested.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ばら売りのふじは、こちらにあります。袋の商品とそれぞれの価格をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The individual Fuji apples are here. Please check the prices of both the bag and individual apples.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四個入り一袋と、ばら売り二個にします。別の品種を足して六個にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四個入り一袋とふじ二個を選び、別品種は足さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take one bag of four and two individual apples. I won't add a different variety just to make six.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose one bag of four and two individual Fuji apples, without adding another variety.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その組合せで六個です。札と商品を確認してレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That combination makes six. Please check the labels and products and take them to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 品種は全部ふじ、合計六個と確認しました。家族にこの内容で買うと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全てふじで六個と確認して家族に購入内容を連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed they are all Fuji and six in total. I'll tell my family this is what I'm buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that all six are Fuji, and say you will tell your family what you are purchasing.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お買上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類のことで何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about the paperwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日付欄は、引っ越す予定だった日ですか。それとも実際に住み始めた日ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談票の日付欄が引越予定か実際の居住開始か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does this date field mean the date I planned to move, or the date I actually started living there?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the date field on the consultation form means your planned move date or actual start of residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この相談票は実際に住み始めた日を伺っています。予定と違いがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This consultation form asks for the date you actually started living there. Was it different from the planned date?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予定は九月二十日でしたが、荷物が遅れて住み始めたのは二十二日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定二十日、荷物遅延で実際は二十二日と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I planned on September 20, but my belongings were delayed, so I started living there on the 22nd.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the planned date was the 20th, but delayed belongings meant you actually moved in on the 22nd.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、その経過を担当に確認してもらいます。ほかの書類にも日付を記入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll ask the person responsible to check those circumstances. Have you also entered a date on other documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この相談票だけ、二十日と書きかけました。正式な届出の書類はまだ書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談票に二十日を書きかけたが正式届出は未記入だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only started writing the 20th on this consultation form. I haven't filled out the official notification documents yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you began writing the 20th only on the consultation form and have not filled in the official notification yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談票は訂正できます。正式な届出の記入は担当で確認してから進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can correct the consultation form. Please check with the person responsible before filling out the official notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予定の二十日と実際の二十二日をメモします。正式な書類にも同じと決めつけず、担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定と実際をメモし、正式書類の欄も担当に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note the planned date of the 20th and the actual date of the 22nd. I won't assume the official form asks for the same date; I'll ask the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the planned and actual dates and also confirm the official form's fields with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。契約日など、別の日付を求める書類もありますので、欄ごとに確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Some documents ask for a different date, such as the contract date, so let's check each field separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予定日、居住開始日、契約日を分けて説明します。今日は相談票の意味を理解してから担当へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定、居住開始、契約日を分け、欄を理解して担当へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the planned date, start of residence and contract date separately. Today I'll understand what the consultation form means before going to the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish the planned date, residence start date and contract date, and understand the field before proceeding to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、担当窓口へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I'll show you to the appropriate counter. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。申告の相談で何をご確認になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to confirm in your tax filing consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先の年の資料と、毎月の明細があります。同じ給与を二度数えないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年の資料と月明細に同じ給与があり二重計上しないか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an annual document from my employer and monthly payslips. I'd like to check that I won't count the same salary twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about avoiding double-counting the same salary appearing in an annual document and monthly payslips.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの書類の名称と、対象の期間を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the name of each document and the period it covers.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この資料は一年分で、明細はその年の十二か月分です。別の勤務先の収入ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一年資料と同年十二か月明細で同じ勤務先だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: This document covers one year, and the payslips cover all twelve months of that same year. They are not income from a different employer.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the annual document and twelve monthly payslips cover the same year and employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ勤務先の同じ期間ですね。記入する額は、担当が資料の種類を確認して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: The same employer and period, then. The adviser will check the document types and explain which amount to enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つの合計を自分で足して書かず、年の資料に月の給与が含まれるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己判断で両方の合計を足さず、年資料に月給与が含まれるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to add both totals and enter them on my own judgment. I'd like to ask whether the monthly wages are already included in the annual document.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not add both totals yourself and want to check whether the annual document includes the monthly wages.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その質問を申告相談の担当へ伝えます。すでに提出した申告書はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that question to the tax filing adviser. Have you already submitted a return?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ提出していません。数字を記入する前に相談するため、資料をそろえて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申告は未提出、数字記入前の相談のため資料持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I brought all the documents to ask about them before entering any figures.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not filed a return and brought documents for advice before entering figures.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類は期間別に並べて担当へお渡しください。ここでは申告額の確定は行いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please arrange the documents by period and give them to the adviser. We don't finalize the amount to declare here.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一年の資料と月の明細を分けて並べます。同じ期間の重なりを担当へ示してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年資料と月明細を分け、同期間の重なりを担当へ示してから記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll arrange the annual document and monthly payslips separately. I'll show the adviser the overlap in the periods before filling it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate the annual document and monthly payslips, show the adviser their overlapping periods, and then fill in the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。申告相談へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to tax filing advice. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お食事で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with your meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の食事券を私が持っています。別々の丼に分けて使いたいので、先に説明を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の食事券を持ち、別々の丼へ配分する説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have meal tickets for two people. We'd like to use them for separate rice bowls, so could you explain how it works first?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have meal tickets for two and would like an explanation of how to divide them between separate bowls.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、ご飯一杯に二枚、具はこちらの表示枚数を使います。券は何枚ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, one serving of rice uses two tickets, and the toppings use the number shown here. How many tickets do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二枚あります。ご飯は二杯なので四枚、その後の具に八枚使えると考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十二枚のうちご飯二杯に四枚、具に八枚と配分を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Twelve. I'm thinking four tickets for two servings of rice, leaving eight for toppings.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your allocation of twelve tickets: four for two rice servings and eight for toppings.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その配分ですね。二人とも同じ具にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: That allocation, then. Would you both like the same toppings?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はこの魚、友人は隣の具です。一つの丼に二人分を全部載せないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分と友人は別の具で、一丼へ全て盛らないでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like this fish, and my friend wants the topping next to it. Please don't put both people's portions together in one bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you and your friend want different toppings, and ask not to put everything into one bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どちらも具は四枚分です。ご飯二杯と合わせて十二枚になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Each of those toppings uses four tickets. Together with two servings of rice, that comes to twelve tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ちょうど十二枚ですね。手前の丼が私、奥の丼が友人のものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 具四枚ずつで合計十二枚と理解し、二つの丼の対応を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Exactly twelve, then. The bowl in front is mine, and the one behind it is my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that four tickets per topping makes twelve in total, and identify which of the two bowls belongs to whom.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つに分けてお作りします。食事券は、この注文の十二枚をまとめてお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll prepare them in two separate bowls. We'll take the twelve tickets for this order together.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この注文分の十二枚を渡します。丼二つ、具は別々という内容を確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十二枚を渡し、別具の丼二つという注文内容を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here are the twelve tickets for this order. We've confirmed the order is two bowls with separate toppings.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over twelve tickets and confirm the order in Japanese: two bowls, each with a different topping.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの丼をご用意します。どうぞお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll prepare two bowls. Please enjoy your meal.
